maria (Docs): Heads-up — opened PR to add LumenX-4B to the model catalog + model card. Need: supported variants, long-context limits, benchmark numbers (throughput/latency for seq=512 and 2048), and compatibility notes for quantized variants and CPU fallback. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12345 cc @alex @jon @sam

alex (Eng ML): Thanks — grabbing bench runs now. Quick numbers from our perf cluster (a100x2): LumenX-4B fp16: ~320 tok/s @ seq=512, int8 (q4_1) on t4: ~95 tok/s @ seq=512. Long context v1 variant supports up to 8192 tokens but perf drops ~40% past 4096. Embed dim: 2048. I'll add a small table to the PR.

jon (Runtime): Note: runtime v1.8 has a kernel mismatch with the q4_0 quant files for LumenX; q4_0 will fallback to CPU and OOM on older CUDA. Recommend calling out "q4_1 or q5" as preferred quant tags for GPU fallback and include a note about runtime 1.9+ for optimal kernels. Also add a short troubleshooting bullet: "if you see KV cache errors, check runtime version + quant tag."

sam (DevEx): I'll update the SDK snippets — need a short python example for streaming + an embeddings call. Suggest we show both generate() with max_new_tokens and embed() with shard_hint. Also will add a Node snippet for the tokenization note.

kevin (QA): Ran batch tests with batch_size=8 on a100, seq=512, and saw p50=28ms/token, p95=72ms/token for fp16. For q4_1 on t4 p50=95ms/token. FWIW batch_size=1 latency is stable. Pasting minimal bench snippet for PR:```
# seq=512, a100x2, fp16
throughput: 320 tok/s
latency_p50: 28 ms/token
latency_p95: 72 ms/token
# seq=2048, a100x2, fp16
throughput: 140 tok/s
latency_p50: 64 ms/token
```

maria (Docs): Perfect — can you add the bench snippet as a small table under "Performance" + a short line in "Limits" about sequence ceilings and when we recommend the v1 long-context variant?

alex (Eng ML): Will do. Also adding a note about expected quality delta between fp16 and int8: small drop on long-form summarization tasks, include an eval note with the prompt set ID we used (#promptset-2026-07).

jon (Runtime): One more: for Private deployments, document that the CPU fallback path increases memory by ~30% due to KV rehousing. Suggest a short "Operational notes" bullet.

sam (DevEx): Drafted the python snippet and pushed to the PR in a separate commit. Snippet shows streaming + function call example and includes the compatibility check code:```python
# check runtime compatibility
from redwood import RuntimeClient
if RuntimeClient.version < "1.9":
    print("Warning: upgrade runtime for optimal quant kernels")
```

pr-checker (bot): PR #12345: all checks passed (lint, link-check, mdx).

maria (Docs): Cool. Two small asks before merge: 1) add an explicit "quant tags supported" list (q4_1, q5, fp16) in the compatibility section; 2) add a short migration note for customers using older q4_0 builds.

kevin (QA): Verified the table entries and the migration note wording. No blockers.

docs-bot (bot): Reminder: schedule publish for docs release v1.28 after merge.

maria (Docs): Great — merging once sam's Node snippet is in and jon ack's runtime note wording. Thanks all :tada:

sam (DevEx): Node snippet pushed — tiny API rename fix addressed.

jon (Runtime): Ack the wording, added the CPU memory numbers.

maria (Docs): Merging now. Will follow up to backport the compatibility note into the "Model catalog legacy" page.

maria (Docs): (after merge) PR merged, will watch the release pipeline. Thanks everyone!"
